name: ETH+BTC volume-confirmed reversal
description: sol-volrev's rule moved unchanged to ETH and BTC: right after a 15-minute window opens, if the previous window moved more than 1.25 sigma on Binance volume more than twice the usual for that quarter-hour slot, buy the reversal side.
hypothesis: Heavy-volume big moves are forced flow that unwinds; the dev screen on SOL showed it, and an unrun screen on ETH/BTC pointed the same way. Rule, thresholds and sizing fixed from sol-volrev, no tuning on ETH/BTC. Losers: takers treating the new window as a coin flip. Wrong if the full CI <= 0, 2x latency loses, or the lockbox loses. Paper/live needs a live volume stream.
